location.zh: 精灵太空站 勇者之塔 神秘领域

label.zh: 第1命：虚无+圣洁, 天生攻击+2
第5命：虚无+圣洁+永恒, 天生双防+2
第6命：轮回(准)+圣洁+永恒，体力低于1000回满

capture.zh: 解开七个封印后挑战谱尼真身；谱尼有6条命（相当于6v6），依次拥有各封印的特性；全部击败获得谱尼精元（另有「传说」称号的说法）。

strategy_notes.zh: 哈莫雷特（满级、双防/体力/攻击努力值，带腰带和双防刻印）龙之意志强化6次后龙王波为主力，魔焰猩猩辅助；仙女龙、闪光艾菲亚等耗招，闪光依依毒粉+寄生种子；最后一命血量低于1300时再用大招，一击打穿1000回满线。全程约1.5小时，需大量药剂（加血、活力药剂各近300个）。

engine_notes: Six lives = six consecutive Puni team members (7k7k 2011: '普尼有6命，其实就是6v6多精灵对战'). Each member carries its own seal traits in member_rules / member_phases — the engine needs per-team-member rules (encounter rules apply to all).

Life traits: 7k7k 2011 gives life 1 = 虚无+圣洁 with 天生攻击+2, life 5 = 圣洁+虚无+永恒 with 天生双防+2, life 6 = 轮回(准)+圣洁+永恒 refilling below 1000 HP; lives 2-4 = 元素/能量/生命 per the spinoff summary (TapTap) which matches 7k7k on lives 1, 5, 6.

HP per life 7000 / 8000 / 9000 / 12000 / 20000 / 65000: the official map-108 table, the 7k7k 2010-10-28 per-life table and 4399 2012-10-18 agree, except life 4, where both 2010 sources give 12000 and the table and the 2012 guide give 10000; 12000 is kept.
heal_full_below 1000 on life 6: to win, the final hit must take it from ≥1000 to 0 in one blow (hence '血量低于1300时可使用大招').
4399 2010 also says the player's hit rate drops when 谱尼 is below 10000 HP (命中率70%) and that its crits remove the player's defence boosts (暴击破防) — not encoded.
Daily limit (once per day) is reported only for the spinoff; the remake has no clock, so attempts_per_day is null.
PP: lives 1-4 have finite PP (35 each), so no_struggle applies and the PP-exhaust tactic works; lives 5-6 have unlimited PP.

Skills (4399 2010-10 seal guides, identical for every seal): 圣光气 10PP, 旋灭裂空阵 10PP, 圣灵魔闪光 5PP, 千烈虚光闪 10PP — 35 PP in total. 圣光气 makes its next two attacks certain crits (下两次攻击必定致命); the classic answer was to switch in two throw-away pets.
Level 105 for all six lives is the official map-108 entry 普尼真身 (seer_data maps.json); the client displays ?? above 100.
Campaign audit: sixth-life 6,500 HP corrected to 65,000 HP from the 2010-10-28 period report.
谱尼的领域 admits only a bag of six level-100 monsters (2013 client MapProcess_108 checkBag(6,100)).
Speed 280 on every life (7k7k 2010-10-28: 谱尼速度280): stat_multipliers spe scales the computed speed to 280.
Immune to stat drops on every life: 7k7k 2010-07-21 tested it (不受状态下降影响（自身不受能力下降影响，又用肯札特迷惑减命中无效）). A 2018 video and a 2023 answer say drops work; they are later.
source_note: 4399 谱尼真身攻略 (2010-10) for lives and HP; 7k7k 2011-03-30 for the per-life seal traits; TapTap summary (spinoff) fills lives 2-4.
